messages:
maria: quick sync - finalizing internal announce for rollout v4.1.0. need blast copy, pinned artifact, and deploybot dry-run before i schedule.
ben: blurb idea: 'v4.1.0: smarter batching reduces tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.' two short lines.
maria: nice. olive, can you confirm pinned artifact for Dedicated customers?
olive: pinned -> runtime-service@v4.1.0 (git: 9c8f7e). i'll add to release notes.
maria: add a rollback guard: auto rollback to v4.0.9 if 4m error rate > 0.7% OR p95 latency +35% for 4m.
chao: can we also implement a soft-throttle for token-cost alerts during canary first 5m so eng doesn't get noise?
pagerduty: recommend raising token-cost threshold by 25% for initial 5m window instead of muting.
maria: @deploy-bot run a staging dry-run for thread 9712345678 so ops/docs can review exact messages.
deploy-bot: staging dry-run started for thread 9712345678. will emit same messages as prod but prefixed [STAGING]. ETA ~90s.
deploy-bot: dry-run output:
- "[STAGING] Release v4.1.0 scheduled. Canary: us-west 25m -> ramp to 60% over 15m. Pin: runtime-service@v4.1.0 (9c8f7e)"
- "Rollback: 4m error rate > 0.7% OR p95 latency increases > 35% -> rollback to v4.0.9"
- "Owners: maria (release), olive (customers), chao (deploy), pagerduty (oncall)"
ben: timings look OK. please add blackout for EU midnight 23:00-02:00 UTC to avoid L10n churn.
maria: updated deploy config. snippet for docs: ```
canary: { region: "us-west", duration: "25m" }
ramp: { to: "60%", duration: "15m" }
blackout: { region: "eu", start: "23:00Z", end: "02:00Z" }
alerts: { initial_token_cost_threshold: "+25%", window: "5m" }
```
olive: perfect. who is posting the internal blast? need it T-7 before canary.
ben: i can post and pin. scheduling for 2024-06-12T09:53:00Z (T-7).
pagerduty: once posted i'll validate escalation policy matches rollback thresholds. note: we'll not auto-escalate for transient blips under the 4m window.
maria: thanks everyone. i'll update the release notes doc with the exact blurb and rollback language. leaving thread open for last-minute edits. :thumbsup:
